# agy-powerline

> A configurable statusline dashboard for Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) supporting Google Gemini (Hydrogen, Neon, Argon, Carbon, Flash) and Anthropic (Claude, Sonnet) models. Tracks quotas with pace markers and run-out forecasts, context window with compaction limits, session and 30-day tokens, estimated spend with budget alerts, agent state, subagents and queued messages, git details with clickable terminal links and fish-style shortening, across 22 WCAG AA themes, 3 layouts, 7 bar languages, and 16 bar-wide settings. Requires Node.js 20+ (Node 22.13+ for cross-conversation token totals via `node:sqlite`); has no runtime dependencies, no network calls, and no telemetry.

## Capabilities
- **Quota pace & forecasts:** Pace markers compare quota consumption against elapsed 5h and 7d window time across Gemini and Anthropic (Claude, Sonnet) buckets. Optional `paceDelta` shows points ahead (`⇡`) or behind (`⇣`) an even pace, and `forecast` estimates when quota runs out at the current rate. Display quotas as remaining or used (`quotaMode`), optionally zero 5h when 7d is empty (`zeroFiveHourWhenWeeklyEmpty`), and keep disabled 3P 5h visible (`showDisabled`).
- **Context, tokens & cost:** Track context window usage against the full window or a soft `compactionLimit` (e.g. `256000`). Monitor session tokens (`totalTokens`, with input/output `split`), prompt cache (`cacheRead`, `cacheCreate`, `cacheHit`), cross-conversation totals (`tokensToday`, `tokensWeek`, `tokensMonth`, read read-only from agy's local SQLite databases on Node 22.13+), and estimated USD spend (`cost`, with optional subagent `split`) with `budget` alerts (`warn`/`crit` colors and `blink`).
- **Git & clickable workspace links:** Show branch, dirty state, ongoing git operations (`REBASE`, `MERGING`, `CHERRY-PICKING`, `REVERTING`, `BISECTING`), ahead/behind counts, line changes (`gitChanges`), file counts (`gitFiles`), commit SHA (`gitSha`), stashes (`gitStash`), and linked worktree (`gitWorktree`). Optional `link` creates clickable OSC 8 hyperlinks to folders (`file`, `vscode`, `cursor`, `zed`) and remote branches/commits; `fish` shortens parent directories (`~/D/r/app`) and branch prefixes (`f/a/oauth-login`).
- **Agent, tasks & environment:** Show active non-default `agent`, `agentState` (including pending tool confirmation), running `tasks` (subagents and background tasks), `queue` (queued user messages), `mode` (approval and Vim modes), `sandbox`, `artifacts`, `env` variables (zero subprocesses; secret-like names blocked), and `exec` shell commands (global install config only).
- **Interactive editor & Settings:** `npx agy-powerline` installs or updates the bar and launches a full-screen TUI editor with six tabs — Widgets (`w`), Presets (`o`), Themes (`t`), Layout (`l`), Powerline (`p`), and Settings (`i`) — plus live scenario switching (`,` `.`: Normal, Near limits, Agent & modes), simulated terminal widths (`-` `+`: 60–120 columns or full), `/` search filtering, and mouse support. The [browser configurator](https://agy-powerline.com/configure/) mirrors the editor with full Settings parity and shareable URLs.
- **Themes, layouts & localization:** 22 WCAG AA themes (dark, light, color-blind safe) plus `custom`, 8 row gradients (`aurora`, `sunset`, `ocean`, `forest`, `neon`, `candy`, `rainbow`, `mono`) or custom hex stops, 9 meter styles (`pips`, `cells`, `dots`, `blocks`, `shade`, `squares`, `braille`, `rings`, `ramp`), 7 bar languages (`en`, `fr`, `es`, `ja`, `zh-CN`, `ko`, `de`), `ascii` mode, `maxWidth`, `alignment`, and `overflow` (`fit` or `wrap`).

## Install
- `npx agy-powerline` installs (or updates outdated scripts) and opens the interactive TUI configurator in a terminal.
- `npx agy-powerline init --yes` installs the statusline non-interactively and wires it into Antigravity settings.
- Restart `agy` once after first install; `npx agy-powerline doctor` checks the installation.

## Commands
- `npx agy-powerline` — Install (if needed), update outdated scripts, and open the editor in an interactive terminal (run `--help` for the command list).
- `npx agy-powerline init [--yes]` — Install or update the statusline.
- `npx agy-powerline configure` — Open the editor (deprecated compatibility alias for `npx agy-powerline`).
- `npx agy-powerline preset <name>` — Apply a preset (`--list` to see them).
- `npx agy-powerline theme <name>` — Switch theme (`--list`, `--gallery`).
- `npx agy-powerline gradient <name>` — Color rows with a gradient (`--list`, `off`); presets: `aurora`, `sunset`, `ocean`, `forest`, `neon`, `candy`, `rainbow`, `mono`.
- `npx agy-powerline layout <pills|lines|classic>` — Switch layout.
- `npx agy-powerline caps <style>` — Switch the pill shape: `round`, `angled`, `slanted`, `flat`.
- `npx agy-powerline export [file]` — Save your config to a file, to back it up or share it.
- `npx agy-powerline import <file>` — Load a config after showing changes (`--merge`).
- `npx agy-powerline doctor` — Check the install and explain what's wrong.
- `npx agy-powerline report` — Write a privacy-safe bug report.
- `npx agy-powerline uninstall [--delete]` — Remove it from agy (`--delete` also removes its files).
- `npx agy-powerline render --demo` — Print the bar with sample data.

## Presets
- `default` — Model, context, git and quota meters.
- `compact` — One-line model, quota, context and git.
- `agent` — Agent state, mode, sandbox and artifacts.
- `git` — Project, branch, worktree, stash and file changes.
- `tokens` — Context, session tokens and cache usage.
- `quotas` — Plan and quota meters.
- `full` — Session, project, git, context, tokens and quotas.

- `colorblind-light`
- `custom` — Your own colors.

## Layouts
- `pills` — Powerline-style capsules.
- `lines` — Plain colored text.
- `classic` — Colored text with `|` dividers and block meters.

## Widgets
- `model` — The model in use.
- `quota` — The quota closest to running out, with its reset.
- `fiveHourBar` — 5-hour quota left as a pace-marked meter.
- `fiveHourPct` — 5-hour quota left as a percentage.
- `fiveHourReset` — Time until the 5-hour quota resets, or its reset time.
- `weeklyBar` — 7-day quota left as a pace-marked meter.
- `weeklyPct` — 7-day quota left as a percentage.
- `weeklyReset` — Time until the 7-day quota resets, or its reset time.
- `thirdPartyFiveHour` — Anthropic (Claude, Sonnet) 5-hour quota left.
- `thirdPartyWeekly` — Anthropic (Claude, Sonnet) 7-day quota left.
- `context` — Context window used as a meter.
- `contextPct` — Context window used as a percentage.
- `contextTokens` — Context tokens used out of the window size.
- `cwd` — Current folder.
- `project` — Project folder name.
- `git` — Branch, uncommitted changes and ahead/behind counts.
- `gitChanges` — Lines added and removed.
- `gitFiles` — Staged, modified, untracked and conflicted file counts.
- `gitSha` — Short ID of the checked-out commit.
- `gitStash` — Number of stashes.
- `gitWorktree` — Name of the linked worktree.
- `plan` — Antigravity plan.
- `agent` — Active non-default agent name.
- `agentState` — What the agent is doing (including pending tool confirmation).
- `sandbox` — Sandbox and network restrictions.
- `artifacts` — Number of artifacts.
- `tasks` — Running subagents and background tasks.
- `queue` — Queued user messages waiting to run.
- `mode` — Approval mode and Vim mode.
- `title` — Current conversation title.
- `sessionTime` — Elapsed time since the active conversation started, from file metadata only.
- `ram` — Memory used on the machine.
- `os` — Operating system running agy (Windows, macOS, Linux or WSL).
- `host` — Current user and short hostname from the OS.
- `version` — Antigravity CLI version.
- `cacheRead` — Prompt-cache tokens read.
- `cacheCreate` — Prompt-cache tokens created.
- `cacheHit` — Prompt-cache usage.
- `totalTokens` — Input and output tokens for the session.
- `cost` — Estimated session spend in US dollars (`cost.total_usd`).
- `clock` — Current local time.
- `tokensToday` — Tokens used today across conversations.
- `tokensWeek` — Tokens used over the last 7 days.
- `tokensMonth` — Tokens used over the last 30 days.
- `exec` — Output from a shell command you configure.
- `env` — Value of an environment variable, hidden when unset.
- `customText` — Your own text.

## Widget options
- `forecast` (`"countdown"`, `"time"`, or `true` to follow `resetFormat`) on `quota`, `fiveHourPct`, `weeklyPct` — Estimates when quota runs out at the current pace; hides when it lasts until reset or during the first 10 minutes of a window.
- `paceDelta` (`true`) on `quota`, `fiveHourPct`, `weeklyPct` — Adds points ahead of (`⇡`) or behind (`⇣`) an even pace over the window.
- `pace` (`true` | `false`) on `fiveHourBar`, `weeklyBar`, `thirdPartyFiveHour`, `thirdPartyWeekly` — Toggles the pace marker per meter widget.
- `meter` (`pips`, `cells`, `dots`, `blocks`, `shade`, `squares`, `braille`, `rings`, `ramp`) on `fiveHourBar`, `weeklyBar`, `thirdPartyFiveHour`, `thirdPartyWeekly`, `context` — Overrides `meterStyle` for that widget.
- `showDisabled` (`true`) on `thirdPartyFiveHour` — Keeps showing the 3P 5h bar when Antigravity marks `quota.3p-5h` disabled.
- `link` on `cwd`, `project` (`"file"` | `true` | `"vscode"` | `"cursor"` | `"zed"`) and `git`, `gitSha` (`true`) — Clickable OSC 8 terminal links to folders, editors, or remote branch/commit URLs (read from `.git/config` with zero spawns; suppressed in `ascii` or `NO_COLOR` mode).
- `fish` (`true`) on `cwd`, `git` — Abbreviates parent directories (`~/D/r/app`) and slash-separated branch prefixes (`f/a/oauth-login`).
- `depth` (`1`–`10`) on `cwd` — Keeps the root and last N folders, collapsing the middle with `…`.
- `budget` (number) on `cost` (USD) and `tokensToday`, `tokensWeek`, `tokensMonth` (tokens) — Adds `%` of budget used and shifts to caution/danger colors (`warn`/`crit`, `blink`) as usage approaches the budget.
- `split` (`true`) on `totalTokens`, `tokensToday`, `tokensWeek`, `tokensMonth` (input `↑` / output `↓` apart) and `cost` (includes subagent spend when subagents were used).
- `compactionLimit` (positive integer tokens, e.g. `256000`) on `context`, `contextPct`, `contextTokens` — Scales context %, meter, denominator, and thresholds to a soft compaction ceiling instead of the full window.
- `showBelow` (`0`–`100`) on quota and reset widgets (`quota`, `fiveHourBar`, `fiveHourPct`, `fiveHourReset`, `weeklyBar`, `weeklyPct`, `weeklyReset`, `thirdPartyFiveHour`, `thirdPartyWeekly`) — Shows only at or below that remaining percentage.
- `showAbove` (`0`–`100`) on `context`, `contextPct`, `contextTokens` — Shows only at or above that used percentage (or when `exceeds_200k_tokens` triggers).
- `format` (`"countdown"` | `"time"` | `"both"`) on `fiveHourReset`, `weeklyReset` — Overrides `resetFormat`.
- `short` (`true`) on `model` — Shortens the model name (e.g. `4 Hydrogen·High`).
- `maxWidth` (`4`–`200`) on `model`, `cwd`, `project`, `git`, `gitWorktree`, `agent`, `title`, `exec`, `env`, `customText` — Clips the displayed value to that column width.
- `operation` (`false`) on `git` — Hides rebase/merge/cherry-pick/revert/bisect operation labels.
- `var` on `env` — Environment variable name (hidden when unset or secret-named).
- `cmd`, `interval`, `timeout`, `payload`, `colors` on `exec`; `text` on `customText`.
- Universal options on any widget: `color`, `textColor`, `bold`, `raw`, `label`, `icon`, plus `warn`, `crit`, `blink` on quota, context, and cross-conversation token widgets (`tokensToday`, `tokensWeek`, `tokensMonth`).

## Config
Default: `~/.agy-powerline/statusline.config.json`; with `AGY_POWERLINE_HOME`, use `$AGY_POWERLINE_HOME/statusline.config.json`. See [Configuration](https://agy-powerline.com/docs/configuration/).
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://agy-powerline.com/schema/v1.json",
  "theme": "dark-aurora",
  "layout": "pills",
  "ascii": false,
  "widgets": [
    { "id": "model" },
    { "id": "context" },
    { "id": "git" }
  ]
}
```

## Rules for assistants
- Do not edit `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json` by hand; run `npx agy-powerline init --yes`.
- Bare `npx agy-powerline` (in a TTY) launches an interactive TUI; do not run it on the user's behalf.
- `import` asks before adding shell commands; never pass `--allow-exec` without approval of the exact commands.
